purpose: Determine whether the approximately 1e-13 float64 R4 threshold recomputation differences change the scientific threshold decision or any clean holdout alarm, without revising R4.

authoritative_thresholds.source: Committed R2 literal values; these remain the only thresholds authorized for any future Phase A.
authoritative_thresholds.recomputed_threshold_role: Provenance diagnostic only; never a replacement threshold.

clean_split_reference.source: Existing R4 clean-only threshold_recomputation evidence produced before this repair.
clean_split_reference.identity_rule: Independently reconstruct exact sorted unique int64 sample-ID arrays from hash-bound clean C0-C3 traces, compare byte-for-byte with the arrays returned by the frozen scientific fit path, and require the following endpoints/counts.
clean_split_reference.sample_id_hash_encoding: SHA-256 over contiguous little-endian int64 bytes, one digest per domain and split.

equivalence_gate: The R2 clean replay inputs, C0-C3 configurations, receiver, scientific code, clean split, and threshold artifact hashes must match their committed R4/R2 bindings.
Exact train, guard1, calibration, guard2, and holdout sample-ID arrays and each count must match the independently reconstructed reference.
The calibration quantile is q=0.99 with NumPy method='higher'; any other method is a provenance failure.
Causal delays, common four-configuration support, at least four common PRNs per scored epoch, and finite scores must pass.
Committed and recomputed thresholds applied with the same strict score>threshold rule to the same recomputed clean holdout score vector must produce byte-identical boolean vectors.
The two alarm vectors must have exactly equal false-positive counts and FPRs.
The committed-threshold holdout FPR must exactly equal OAK 0.00730093543235227 and TEX 0.012708150744960562.
Numeric tolerance alone cannot pass the repair; every hash, split, support, decision, and FPR condition must pass.
Any control score read or any attack path stat/hash/open/mmap/read forces INCONCLUSIVE_THRESHOLD_DECISION_PROVENANCE.

fixed_computation.alarm_vector_encoding: one uint8 byte per boolean in holdout sample order

post_result_rule: No preregistered condition, tolerance, threshold, split, support rule, or verdict rule may change after results are observed.
preregistration_commit_binding: The pushed preregistration commit SHA is recorded in preregistration_commit.json only after local/remote identity and ahead/behind 0/0 are verified.
